# Jaden Matson

> Jaden Matson is a San Diego multifamily investment associate at Apartment Realty Group (California DRE #02298761). Jaden helps owners and investors sell, buy, value and 1031-exchange apartment buildings and 2–4 unit properties across San Diego County.

## Services
- Seller representation for 2–4 unit properties and small-to-mid-size apartment buildings
- Free broker opinion of value (NOI, cap rate, price per unit, comparable sales)
- Buyer and 1031 exchange replacement-property representation
- San Diego multifamily market research

## Markets
Pacific Beach, Ocean Beach, La Jolla, North Park, Hillcrest, Mission Hills, Normal Heights, Chula Vista, Oceanside
